script.text: After Sylvio's failed attempt to steal Yuya's Pendulum Cards, Zuzu kept a close eye on the thief.
I heard you planning to get some payback on Yuya – well, I'm not gonna let you! Duel me right here, right now instead!
You can't be serious?
What's wrong? Afraid you'll rack up another loss?
You're on, Zuzu.
Hope I'm not interrupting.
Yuya?
Can't ya see we're in the middle of something? We're about to duel!
Yes… WE are.
I Xyz Summon… Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon!
Ahh!
News of the mystery man's attack on Sylvio spread like wildfire, all the way to the You Show Duel School.
So strange… Was that Yuya? I just… don't know…
Since we're learning about summoning today, can you teach us how to Xyz Summon?
No, I'm afraid not. After all, I can't teach what I don't know! Why? You know someone who's mastered it, Zuzu?
I'm… not sure…
Hey! Leo folks are accusing Yuya of hurting their pal Sylvio in a duel!
Yuya?!
Me-ya?!
Perhaps I can be of some assistance.
I know you – you're Henrietta Akaba…
Yes. Chairwoman of the Leo Institute of Dueling. Why don't we all have a little talk?
I'm afraid we must deal with the facts. And the facts are that Yuya has created quite a row.
Yuya, did you do this?
No no no! Why doesn't anyone believe me?
Gong does. Now who's with Gong?
I know what my eyes saw that day… But sometimes, looks can deceive…
It's okay, Zuzu. Just say what's in your heart.
My heart? My heart says... you're innocent!
How sweet. But that changes nothing. Unless you want me to get the authorities involved, I suggest that you listen to my proposal.
Yuya made a fool of our student! This is now about honor! One that we'll soon restore! By having our students battle in a duel! Best two out of three!
If your school wins, then I'll forget about the Yuya incident.
But if we win the duel… Then effective immediately, the Leo Institute will take over the You Show Duel School.
Did you set this all up simply to take our school?
No, I did not. But when I see an opportunity such as this, I can't resist.
You see, there are three ultimate summoning methods: Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz. But it's come to my attention that there is now a fourth method – Pendulum.
With all due respect, the potential of Pendulum Summoning is wasted here.
You treat dueling like it's a business! But here, we believe it's all about SHOW business! That's when dueling is at its most powerful – when it's used to make people happy!
But if you really feel like your school has lost its rep, and that the only way to get it back is by dueling, then that's fine.
But that duel is gonna have to be with me!
Gong totally feels the exact same way that you do! Gong's volunteering to face off in a match as well!
But you're not a member of You Show Duel School.
Let's duel!
It seems your students have agreed to my terms, but what say you?
Madame Chairwoman, what I say is… you have a deal!
The students I've brought over from the Leo Institute are at the top of their class. The one facing Yuya will be... Dipper!
That's my name! And don't you dare forget it!
Here we go! It's showtime!
